title: Ice becomes liquid
hook: Predict the result, then reveal the model.

knows: Symbols can represent chemical substances or states.
doesNotKnow: Melting changes the physical state of water. The H₂O molecules remain water molecules; their arrangement and movement change as the solid becomes liquid.

misconception: The process produces a different result from the one shown.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: When pure ice melts, what happens to its H₂O molecules? Melting changes the physical state of water. The H₂O molecules remain water molecules; their arrangement and movement change as the solid becomes liquid.
The circles are symbolic labels, not molecular structures, and the model omits other conditions or intermediate steps.
